notes.title: Discover the origins of VERLIES with this free DLC!
notes.content:
Verlies is a dungeon crawler / Hack & Slash taking place in dungeons filled with deadly traps, chests and other randomly generated stuff. You will be facing enemies, searching for equipment and powerful scrolls, and meeting NPCs offering various services for a fee. All of this being randomly generated, from start to finish (spells' cost and power, enemies' strenght, gear's statistics, location of the NPC, etc ...). It's impossible to play the same game twice !

To face these traps waiting to kill you at every corner you cross and every box you open, you will have 12 "jobs" to choose from. They will allow you to build your own and unique character.

Building a balanced game (difficulty, economy, ...) was one of the main objective of the development, and was conducted with the utmost care. You will definitively have a hard time choosing between the various services offered by the NPCs (sale & purchase, maintenance of the gear, blessings, forging of new items, etc...).

-Key Features
-Game randomly generated
-60 dungeons
-4 levels of difficulty
-Loot, loot and loot
-Fully moddable

-And free! Merry Christmas to everyone!

notes.title: Double Cheese Burger Update! (1.2)
notes.content:
[img]http://tof.canardpc.com/view/9e6e27a4-5718-45fb-abd6-132a7f061d9d.jpg[/img]

This is the second update for Verlies II! The game becomes completely moddable, all graphics and sound files are replaceable! You can now create a total conversion for Verlies II.

[B]Major update:[/B]
- The game becomes completely moddable!

[B]Minor update:[/B]
- Added a "fast dice game" option
- Added a "skip intro" option
- Added a "how to play" option
- Added a "fast restart" option when you die
- Added a sound control option

[B]Improvement:[/B]
- The functions "restart" relaunches the game directly in the start city with your previous character
- Loading time at launch is reduced on some configs

[B]Balancing:[/B]
- Nepheron can not exceed 666 HP

notes.title: Little Kitty Update! (1.1)
notes.content:
[img]http://tof.canardpc.com/view/ac86f107-d059-4215-9bba-adbe174314c6.jpg[/img]

I am pleased to announce the first update of Verlies II!

[B]Major update:[/B]
- Added a "Little soft kitty" mode for the most fragile players (but no achievements progressions unlocks, cowards)

[B]Minor update:[/B]
- All cutscenes and transitions scenes are now skippable by pressing a button (you can now start a game in 10 seconds against 40 before)
- Added a "restart game" option
- Added a "help me" option

[B]Balancing:[/B]
- "Ice breath" magic nerfed
- Concentration skill is more powerful but are only active in fight

[B]Bugs fixes:[/B]
- Fixed a bug that did not save the "full screen" option
- Fixed a bug when trying to transform the final boss in frog (what disrespect anyway!)
- Fixed a bug when trying to steal and hit at the same time
- Fixed a bug that allowed to open chests in fight
- Fixed several minor bugs
- Fixed some bugs that can cause crashes

notes.title: VERLIES II, described in a few words
notes.content:
[b]VERLIES II[/b] is a ruthless dungeon crawler game. The player embodies a hero he can select from eight brave adventurers willing to enter a mysterious dungeon filled with ancient forgotten treasures.

The game revolves around a village where the player is offered many different services (blacksmith, merchant, magician, inn, money games etc.) so he can get ready and go as far as possible in the depths of the cursed dungeon. Relentless monsters, numerous treasures, ferocious traps, immersive puzzles, many dangers await him inside, especially as death is final.

Unlike many games that only offer quests that are easy to solve, everything that stand on the way of the player in [b]VERLIES II[/b] was conceived to stop it. 
Only the bests and most determined will feel the pride of experiencing the end!
